source.name: SportsPro - Report: Boston Red Sox bag US$170m MassMutual jersey patch deal
source.note: Value as reported by Sports Business Journal, cited here before the official announcement; SportsPro adds the pact 'could reportedly rise to as much as US$20 million per season' with performance bonuses, so no up-to figure is recorded. The club confirmed the ten-year partnership on 2022-11-30 (MLB.com: https://www.mlb.com/news/red-sox-jersey-patch-massmutual), so 'to' is left null rather than derived from the term.
source.quote: have agreed a ten-year, US$170 million jersey patch sponsorship with insurance company MassMutual, according to Sports Business Journal (SBJ)

note: Jersey patch, worn on the sleeve.
